events.title: Tutorial & Help System Improved!
events.summary: Thanks to your feedback, we've made the tutorial and help system in Metromino a little better and easier to understand!We've added short tutorial videos directly to the Help window, showing key gameplay mechanics in action so you can learn how to play faster.Thank you to everyone sharing feedback and suggestions! You're helping make Metromino better with every update.

events.title: Steam Achievements Are Here!
events.summary: Build a massive metropolis, become a billionaire, fill an entire map with 9,801 cells, or try some unusual strategies along the way. All achievements are now integrated with Steam and will be available in the full version of Metromino. And there's more coming! By the way, if you've already played the demo, I'd love to hear your feedback! Your thoughts will help me improve the game and make Metromino even better.

events.title: Let Me See Those Tiny Houses!
events.summary: Let Me See Those Tiny Houses!The first feedback from Metromino players made one thing very clear: you want to see those tiny houses up close!So I made it possible.You can now zoom the camera in much closer and get a better look at your city - the houses, streets, and all those little details that were previously just a bit too tiny.It may be a small update, but it came directly from your feedback.Thank you to everyone who has played the demo and shared their thoughts.
